subject.title: Feature Request: Custom TUI Footer Fields for Cost/Balance/Rate Limit Status

question: Should persistent TUI footer observability be solved as a core `tui` config template, a PluginStatusProvider-style SDK/rendering seam, or kept out of the persistent footer?
rationale: The request crosses public config, TUI rendering, provider/auth usage lookups, and Plugin SDK boundaries; automation cannot safely choose the long-term compatibility and security contract.

options.title: Plugin/API-first footer seam
options.body: Approve or refine the PluginStatusProvider direction, then add TUI rendering and provider-usage contributions only after ordering, truncation, caching, and failure semantics are settled.

options.title: Core config template
options.body: Add a first-class `tui` footer template/config surface and accept the migration, docs, and compatibility burden of a new public config contract.

options.title: Keep existing status surfaces
options.body: Keep `/status`, `/usage`, CLI status, and menu-bar usage as the supported quota/cost surfaces and close persistent footer customization as not planned.

recommendation.title: Plugin/API-first footer seam
recommendation.body: Approve or refine the PluginStatusProvider direction, then add TUI rendering and provider-usage contributions only after ordering, truncation, caching, and failure semantics are settled.

likelyOwner.reason: Their git history and ownership signals span the TUI footer, usage-footer modes, and provider usage/status surfaces involved in the decision.
